name: SD: Restaurant service (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A restaurant's floor and kitchen, counted every minute over three twelve-hour service days: guests waiting for a table, guests seated, orders waiting for the kitchen, dishes cooking, dishes ready at the pass, and dishes served so far. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the restaurant (the ground truth is in sd-restaurant/truth.model.json, including a stock nobody counts). Guests come in waves nobody announces; staffing changes on the line are announced as eras. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
